name: Amara Wrap Midi Dress
image_descriptions: Rust-orange wrap dress with a fitted bodice and flared midi skirt, worn outdoors on grass
Close-up of the fabric showing a soft brushed texture with subtle drape, 3/4 sleeves gathered at the cuff

reviews.text: The wrap tie is adjustable and stayed secure all day at an outdoor fall wedding. True to size.
Gorgeous color for autumn but the fabric wrinkles if you sit for a while.
Runs slightly long on my 5'3" frame, needed to hem it.

name: Solstice Velvet Slip Dress
weather_notes: warm fabric but sleeveless, best layered with a shawl below 65F
image_descriptions: Deep emerald velvet slip dress with a bias-cut skirt that skims the body, thin adjustable straps
Detail shot showing the velvet's soft sheen catching indoor light

reviews.text: Feels luxurious and the velvet doesn't crush easily. Got so many compliments.
Beautiful but I needed a wrap since it's sleeveless and my wedding was outdoors in October.
Bias cut is very forgiving, fits close without being tight.

name: Hawthorn Tweed Shift Dress
weather_notes: heavier woven fabric, warm to 45F, holds shape in wind
image_descriptions: Camel and cream tweed shift dress with a structured boxy fit, long sleeves, standing in a garden setting
Close-up of the tweed weave showing a flecked wool-blend texture with visible structure, not stretchy

reviews.text: Perfect for an outdoor fall wedding, warm enough without a jacket until sunset.
Structured fit means it doesn't cling, but it's not very stretchy so sitting for long periods feels stiff.
The tweed held up great in the wind, didn't fly around like my friend's chiffon dress.

name: Meridian Chiffon Maxi Dress
weather_notes: lightweight, breathable, best above 68F; flows a lot in wind
image_descriptions: Dusty rose flowy chiffon maxi dress with shoulder ties, skirt caught mid-movement by a breeze
Fabric detail showing sheer, lightweight chiffon layered over a lining

reviews.text: Beautiful color but way too light for a fall outdoor wedding, I was cold and the skirt wouldn't stop blowing around.
Perfect for a warm summer garden wedding, very breathable.
Lovely flowy movement but definitely a warm-weather dress.

name: Fairmont Wool Suit (Jacket + Trouser)
weather_notes: heavier fabric, warm to 40F, structured against wind
image_descriptions: Charcoal grey tailored wool suit, fitted blazer and straight-leg trousers, worn outdoors near stone steps
Close-up of the twill weave showing a fine diagonal texture, structured shoulder

reviews.text: Warm enough for an October outdoor wedding and still looked sharp for evening photos.
Tailoring is great off the rack but I'd size down one for a slimmer fit.
Fabric has some stretch in the trousers which I appreciated for sitting through a long ceremony.

name: Birchwood Corduroy Blazer Dress
weather_notes: medium-heavy fabric, warm to 50F, some wind resistance
image_descriptions: Burnt sienna corduroy blazer dress with a belted waist and notched lapel, worn outdoors among fall leaves
Texture close-up showing visible corduroy ridges, medium wale

reviews.text: Unique take on wedding-guest attire, warm and stylish, though the belt buckle dug in a bit when seated.
Loved the texture, felt very fall-appropriate and photographed beautifully outdoors.
Corduroy shows creasing after sitting for the ceremony.

name: Rowan Straight-Leg Jeans
weather_notes: medium-weight denim, comfortable across most seasons, warm enough for mild cold
image_descriptions: Mid-wash blue straight-leg jeans, mid-rise, standing pose showing a relaxed but tailored leg line
Close-up of the denim weave showing a classic twill texture with slight stretch

reviews.text: The 2% stretch makes these way more comfortable than rigid denim, easy to move in all day.
True to size, mid-rise sits comfortably without digging in when seated.
Great everyday jeans, held their shape after several washes.

name: Dalton Vintage Wide-Leg Jeans
weather_notes: heavier rigid denim, warm to 45F, no stretch
image_descriptions: Dark indigo wide-leg jeans, high-rise waist, wide flowing leg opening, worn with sneakers
Detail shot of the rigid denim's deep indigo dye and visible stitching

reviews.text: Love the vintage wide-leg cut, very flattering and warm for fall days.
No stretch at all so they take a wash or two to break in and soften up.
High-rise stays put, great with a tucked-in top.

name: Sable Silk Button-Down Top
weather_notes: lightweight silk, best layered in cold weather, breathable indoors
image_descriptions: Ivory silk button-down top with a relaxed fit and long sleeves, worn tucked into trousers
Close-up of the silk's smooth sheen and mother-of-pearl buttons

reviews.text: Feels luxurious against the skin and drapes beautifully, great for the office or a dinner out.
Gorgeous top but silk needs careful washing, I hand-wash mine.
Pairs perfectly with jeans for a smart-casual look.

name: Marlowe Ribbed Knit Top
weather_notes: midweight ribbed knit, warm to 50F on its own, layers well below that
image_descriptions: Heather grey ribbed knit top with a fitted crew neck, worn with jeans in an outdoor setting
Close-up of the ribbed knit texture showing visible vertical ribbing

reviews.text: Soft, warm, and stretchy, my go-to fall layering top.
Fits true to size and holds its shape wash after wash.
A bit thin on its own in real cold, I layer it under a jacket.
